primary_estimands: r_popularity between partners of mutually accepting dyads, popularity from OTHER dates and excluding focal dyad, at least 3 remaining exposures per participant
event-conditioned permutation null for matched popularity correlation preserving mutual counts per wave
difference observed mutual vs event-wise independent null (male and female approvals shuffled within wave)
difference observed mutual vs woman-wave approval-rate-preserving null
secondary: null preserving both male-wave and woman-wave approval rate
event-cluster resampling exploratory 95% percentile for r

simulation_contract.match_sampling: one woman-side row per wave+dyad; each participant may have multiple dyads; exact 1:1 mirror QC
simulation_contract.labels: woman_dec=dec in gender0 row; man_dec=dec_o; mutual=match
simulation_contract.proxy: other people’s positive votes received per person, excluding focal pair, with at least 3 other encounters
simulation_contract.control_event: shuffle female_dec within wave and hold male_dec fixed; no shuffle of individual IDs
simulation_contract.control_female: shuffle female_dec within woman x wave, male fixed
simulation_contract.control_both: independently shuffle female_dec within woman x wave and male_dec within man x wave
simulation_contract.null_popularity: hold popularity proxy and observed wave fixed, shuffle mutual flags among dyads within wave keeping matches per wave

validity_gates: If >0 mirror disagreements or duplicate ambiguous dyads, stop and record invalid rather than repair silently
If <60 mutual dyads with at least three OTHER encounters both sides, no popularity claim
If <5 waves with eligible matches, stop matched comparison
Nulls require >=1000 permutations; disclose adaptive selection and retrospective exploratory nature

respondents in same event not independent; uncertainty event cluster
model score value latente is not identical to popularity proxy
original Columbia sample contains known past reprocessing; record cleaned source lineage
